text:
sam: Hey folks — opened PR with sparse quant profile and a handful of tokenizer compatibility tweaks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4321
maya: looking now, thanks for the ping. is this safe to merge without a migration step?
rachel: quick skim — the quant profile looks fine but there's a small change to tokenizer/vocab.json that might affect older cached embeddings.
sam: good call. the change to vocab.json is just a corrected escape sequence for a special token, no new tokens added. I ran the embedding smoke locally against the cached set and saw no drift in distances.
maya: can you paste the local diff/command you used? would like to reproduce quickly.
sam: sure — ran: `python tests/embeddings_autotest.py --dataset=cache_small --profile=sparse-quant` and compared hashes with `sha256sum outputs/*.npy`. diffs were nil.
ci-bot: CI started for pr #4321 — unit tests (linux, py3.10), lint, quant-smoke.
maya: thanks. left one nit about a comment in quant/profile.yaml (minor). also suggest adding a one-line note in the model catalog entry about expected perf change (2-3% token throughput improvement).
sam: added the note and pushed new commit. PTAL @maya @rachel
ci-bot: CI passed for pr #4321 — all checks successful.
rachel: LGTM modulo the vocab note — can you add a changelog line so infra knows to invalidate caches if needed?
sam: added changelog and a short rollback note. will merge after an approval from maya.
maya: quick 👍 from me. small nit already addressed.
ops-bot: FYI — if merged, scheduled rollout to dedicated pool 'gpu-ondemand' at 18:00 UTC will pick up new profile (can be paused).
sam: thanks @ops-bot. planning to merge at 16:30 PT / 23:30 UTC unless anyone objects earlier. can someone click approve on GitHub?
rachel: approving now.
maya: approved.
sam: merging now. :rocket:
ci-bot: Merge recorded: PR #4321 merged into main by sam.
ops-bot: Rollout pending — enabling canary at 23:30 UTC, will monitor latency and error rate for 30m.
sam: will watch the canary dashboard and report back if anything odd.
rachel: nice, thanks for the quick follow-up.
maya: thanks all.
